card.situation:
Combined Synopsis/Solicitation for non-personal landscape services (lawn care and grounds keeping) at the NWS Weather Forecast Office, 104 Airport Road, Dodge City, KS 67801 — firm-fixed-price purchase order, base year plus four option years, small business set-aside, NAICS 561730.
Reached the owner because Red Cedar matches NAICS 561730 exactly, holds Total Small Business set-aside eligibility, and has directly relevant federal grounds maintenance past performance (Tinker AFB).
reasons_for: Red Cedar's grounds maintenance capability (mowing, trimming, irrigation) and Tinker AFB cantonment grounds contract directly match the SOW scope and NAICS 561730 requirement [profile: past performance, Tinker AFB grounds maintenance].
The acquisition is a Total Small Business set-aside and Red Cedar is confirmed eligible, removing any large-business competition barrier [set_aside_note: SBA listed among firm's eligible set-asides].

Incumbent pricing of $21,475 aggregate over five years signals a very small, low-complexity contract well within Red Cedar's operational capacity as a 38-employee firm [81935751-01c68c24-p18-dddd10e4].
reasons_against: Dodge City, KS is approximately 370 miles from Oklahoma City, directly violating owner rule [rc-distance] which prohibits bids more than 200 miles from Oklahoma City [81935751-266263a0-p1-1e6fd84f].

Active services in the base period run only through 10/31/2026 (2–5 months depending on award date), triggering owner rule [rc-base] which prohibits bids where the base period active service window is under 12 months [81935751-01c68c24-p2-c1388fa4].

SAM registration, FedConnect registration, and IPP electronic invoicing capability are all unconfirmed in the firm profile, creating three eligibility-for-award unknowns that cannot be resolved without additional verification [81935751-01c68c24-p34-f535489a, 81935751-01c68c24-p12-a0dcf44c, 81935751-01c68c24-p26-8253f71d].

drafts.capability_statement:
Red Cedar Facility Services is a small business concern eligible for Total Small Business set-aside acquisitions under NAICS 561730 (Landscaping Services). We provide non-personal grounds maintenance services — including mowing, trimming, edging, and irrigation management — to federal facilities, supplying all labor, supervision, tools, equipment, and materials required under firm-fixed-price contracts.

Our directly relevant past performance includes a multi-year grounds maintenance contract covering the cantonment area at Tinker Air Force Base, Oklahoma (NAICS 561730, 2021–2024), where we maintained large turf areas to federal standards, managed debris removal, and operated under federal facility access and security sign-in protocols consistent with those required at NWS WFO Dodge City.

Red Cedar employs OSHA 30-certified supervisors and operates a quality control inspection program with findings logged in a computerized maintenance management system (CMMS), supporting the detailed technical approach and documentation requirements of this solicitation. Our workforce is enrolled in e-Verify, supporting the personnel security processing requirements applicable to Department of Commerce facilities.

We are a Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB) and Economically Disadvantaged Women-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB), and we hold the compliance infrastructure — reps and certs, e-Verify, and QC documentation — required for federal purchase order performance.

We respectfully submit this statement of qualifications in response to Solicitation No. 819357517c044e6489e51644fc101775 and welcome the opportunity to discuss our approach with the contracting officer.

Point of Contact: Red Cedar Facility Services | red-cedar | kirsten.keen@noaa.gov

reader.scope_summary: The government is buying non-personal landscape services (lawn care and other grounds keeping) for the National Weather Service Weather Forecast Office located at 104 Airport Road, Dodge City, KS 67801, with the contractor providing all tools, equipment, materials, and supervision. The contract is structured as a firm-fixed-price purchase order with a base year (services provided through 10/31/2026) and four option years, each with services provided April through October, for a total potential duration of five years. The acquisition is set aside for small business concerns under NAICS 561730 with a $9.5M size standard.
